links.outcome: mSTOP predictive performance compared with CT imaging for identifying non-responders
links.effect: mSTOP identified 35.1% of nonresponding patients with PPV 84.8%, comparable to CT-imaging; combined with CT, PPV rose to 95.7% identifying 19.8% of non-responders.
links.quote: mSTOP identified 35.1 % of nonresponding patients, with a positive predictive value (PPV) of 84.8 %, which was comparable to CT-imaging.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of mSTOP on dual-center historical validation cohort
links.effect: In 242 metastatic NSCLC patients, mSTOP identified 35.1% of non-responders with PPV 84.8%.
links.quote: Diagnostic accuracy was based on a dual-center validation cohort of 242 metastatic NSCLC patients.

unlisted_practices: Multi-parametric QC strategy for real-time laboratory prediction model operation
Discrete event simulation to estimate clinical and financial impact of a prediction model

screen.reason: The study tests the clinical and financial impact via discrete event simulation, and designs and evaluates a multi-parametric QC strategy and ICT system for real-time operation of an ML prediction model.

primary.practice: multi-parametric quality control strategy and ICT integration
